questions.prompt: Which sentence uses American English spelling?
options: The ghost's favourite colour is green.
The ghost's favorite color is green.
The ghost's favourit colur is green.
questions.solution: The ghost's favorite color is green.
questions.hint: American spelling usually leaves out the u in these two words.
